description: A four-channel mixer, each channel with its own level knob, summed to a single output

params.text: Sets the level of that channel in the sum, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: One of the four signals to be summed, scaled by its own level knob

outputs.text: The four channels summed, carrying as many polyphonic channels as the widest input

notes: the lamp turns red once the sum passes 10V and otherwise brightens with the level of the sum
nothing limits the sum, so four hot signals at full level can leave the output well past 10V
